sources.quote: The Sun is a G-type main-sequence star
Proxima Centauri, the star nearest to the Sun, is a red dwarf, as are fifty of the sixty nearest stars.

notes: Fictional relation insert (TBox): a real class with a made-up property. All four derived queries are determinate (allowed for relation inserts): a new star named in the prompt, and three well-known members (the Sun, Proxima Centauri through red dwarf ⊑ main-sequence star, Sirius A), which the model knows only as members, since nothing stored about them mentions a dovric number. Near query (the Sun's spectral type) is about a member and does not depend on the insert.
